newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends slightly lower at 1,036.40.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends slightly lower at 1,036.40.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed slightly lower for the fourth consecutive trading session, ending at 1,036.40 after a day of lackluster trading on the country's interbank market.
"It was real quiet. There were a few clients demanding dollars because of the low rate (for U.S. currency) but nothing else was going on," one trader said in a telephone interview.
The peso fell just 10 centavos from Friday's close and held in a tight 1,036.20 to 1,037.40 range. Dealers reported 202 trades for a total of $78 million.
